summary: Fractyl Health filed an 8-K under Items 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing topline six-month results from the REMAIN-1 pivotal cohort of its Revita DMR System, a randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled study in maintaining weight loss after GLP-1 therapy discontinuation. In the mITT population (N=308), Revita participants retained roughly 80% of GLP-1-induced weight loss versus 67% for sham (5.1% versus 8.2% regain; p=0.0023), with 32% weight-stable or losing further versus 18%. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor or deal mechanics are disclosed; the filing is a clinical-data disclosure, not a special situation.
